verdict: Rulings 39, 41 and 43 hold in the sim on fresh seeds. There are no blockers. Stuck wall clicks: 0 gate-A fails body-free on 10,240 + 800 clicks. The same body-free sweep on the pre-ruling-39 lane files gives 28 gate-A fails, 13 near-dead and 2 dead clicks. Wave clicks: 2,176 a map (seeds 41, 57, 61, 77, 83, 97, 111, 123) with 0 dither, 0 detours, 0 walks away from the goal and 1 RIFT short end (2.44 m: an enemy wave walked into the path and stopped). Held moves: 0 unforced regressions, early or late. Pick truth: 0 wrong of 3.21 M pair clicks and 217,673 clump clicks. attackAt: the hero never walks unshoved in 1,920 real-map presses, 0 shots past reach, 0 Z presses that damage a non-fighter. Determinism: identical twice on RIFT and BRIDGE for 2 streams each. Strict still-Wick sweep: 0 / 0 on fresh seeds 411-416 (36 games). The full soak reproduces ruling 43's failing gates value for value. None of them is this lane's except the BRIDGE median length. In a paired A/B over 280 games the lane shortens BRIDGE by 0.57 min (s.e. 0.29), which contradicts ruling 43's 'BRIDGE is not shortened'. The pooled median is still in band (15.3 vs 15.85 min) and the RIFT adept pace is better with the lane. Every player-visible movement measure is better than the pre-ruling-39 controls on the same seeds. Minors: a Z re-press during a plain targeted windup on a Wick still lands on the Wick; 5 of 794 ground shots clip a wall corner by <= 0.26 m.

minors.summary: This lane shortens BRIDGE bot games by 0.57 min (s.e. 0.29, 280 paired games, same bots code, seeds 1-140 adept + veteran). Pooled median is 15.32 with the lane vs 15.85 without (gate 15-18 min). Adept 14.39 vs 15.39 (-0.63 +- 0.38); veteran 15.88 vs 16.55 (-0.50 +- 0.43). The seeds 1-20 set fails the gate at 14.8 (OFF 16.3); seeds 21-40 pass at 15.8 (OFF 15.3); seeds 41-140 pass at 15.2 (OFF 15.8). Ruling 43 measured only passOwn in isolation (+0.21); the whole lane against pre-ruling-39 is about 2 s.e. shorter. Reported, not relaxed. It is a pace gate, not a control the player feels.

A plain Shift+left on a Wick (targeted windup), then within the 0.27 s windup a Z+Shift+left elsewhere: the windup still lands on the Wick (r4 verifier's _tmp_vfy_ctl_r4_attackat 'after a Z re-press the Wick windup does not land' FAILS: wick hits 1, fighter hits 0; _tmp_vfy_ctl_r4_reaim r4_archer first=attackAt newPress z=true -> Wick hits 1). The re-press re-aims without restarting the windup (ruling 41), but its fighters-only flag does not drop a non-fighter windup target. That is one attack in a 0.27 s window, against ruling 43's 'a swing / shot under Z hits only a fighter'.

On the real maps, 5 of 794 aimed ground shots crossed non-wall-free ground for 0.02-0.26 m (RIFT dunsom x2, odrum x2, vashil; speeds 18-20 m/s, cell 0.5 m). projectiles.ts tests walls only at each tick's step end (0.6-0.67 m steps), so a shot can cut a wall corner. None crossed more than 0.26 m. No hit through a wall was observed, and the r3 fuzz 'no hit through the wall' passes. This step-end test is the projectile system's, older than ruling 39; ground shots inherit it.

Waves sampler, fresh seeds 61/77/97: RIFT 1 / 816 single clicks ended 2.44 m short of an uncrowded goal with a 1.26x lane at the start (ilsheta s61 t1998). WDIAG trace: from q6 to q12 four enemy Wicks walked into the line and stood (v 0) across it at y ~ 14, between a structure disc and the goal. The hero pressed through them at 0.05-0.1 m a tick and the no-progress windows ended the move. This is an enemy body block that formed after the click (ruling 43 reads such cases as body blocks). The same seeds under the pre-ruling-39 files gave 1 short move at 6.96 m on RIFT. Fresh seeds 41/57/83/111/123 (1,360 a map) gave 0 on every waves gate.

Walls sweep (fresh WALLS_SEED 23, 2,200 clicks a map, 5 radii): far 0 / 0, but long 3 / 4 and away 0 / 2 (RIFT / BRIDGE). Every one is a stuck click: ruling 43's rescue walks round to the nearest open point. The worst walks were 30.8 m against 15.4 m net (RIFT ilsheta deep) and 1.76 m away from the click (BRIDGE ervet). Non-stuck: 0 / 0 / 0. The pre-ruling-39 files give 0 / 0 / 0 on this sweep, but their stuck clicks are the dead / near-dead clicks in the snap sweep (28 gate-A fails). A rescue walk of up to 2x straight + 2 m round an obstacle can read as 'runs around on its own' to a player. That cap is by design (ruling 41).

Held after 8:00 with all seats played (seeds 31 / 43, 384 a map): 3+ reversals 1 / 7, 5+ reversals 0 / 1 (BRIDGE sukri s43 k9, 5). All of them are tagged forced (an enemy's CC or a shove faster than the walk). Unforced regress > 1 m: 0 / 0. Same seeds pre-ruling-39: 3+ reversals 8 / 9, 5+ 1 / 2, revMax 7 / 8, unforced regress 0 / 2, uncrowded short 0 / 2.

Wave clicks: detours 2 / 9 -> 0 / 0, walked away 1 / 1 -> 0 / 0, reversals 33 / 50 -> 6 / 9, short 1 / 0 -> 1 / 0 (2.44 m vs 6.96 m). Late held: 3+ reversals 8 / 9 -> 1 / 7, unforced regress 0 / 2 -> 0 / 0, uncrowded short 0 / 2 -> 0 / 0. Pick truth: 0 wrong (098ac7436 had 216 / 15). Attack in place is new and works.
